status: Working source-informed drum and flywheel reconstruction; qualification pending

evidence.drum: SNL83:034 SH866A, quantity1, Plate21callout2. Cone face derives from qualified lining, selected statically engaged.6mm stock,25mm bend and flange profile are estimates.
evidence.screws: SNL201:002 SH866B, quantity6,5/8x1-1/4in, threaded1in, drilled hex head, securing drum to flywheel. Head dimensions, circle and receiving fits are estimates; thread is a smooth envelope.
evidence.wire: SNL276:004 SH866C, one48in/1219.2mm soft-steel W.&M.No16 wire.1.5mm diameter is an estimate, not a gauge conversion. Route and paired twist inferred.
evidence.flywheel_diameter: HB115 largest diameter19.811in; conditional transfer to SH868A. Printed diameter takes precedence over uncalibrated dashed outline in SNL21.
evidence.hub: HB71/111 section connects the removable flywheel body to its long hub; taper/key and removal access imply the positive-drive teeth belong on that hub extension. HB prose calls these crankshaft teeth. This remains a documented interpretation, not a recovered manufacturing drawing.
evidence.bore: Conical bore and full through keyway follow removable tapered/keyed mounting. Both taper endpoints and slot dimensions are estimates. Front radius33.3375 uses the nominal2.625in crankshaft journal as an inference, not a printed hub bore.
evidence.starter_teeth: HB162-165 explicitly requires flywheel teeth and9.525mm disengaged axial clearance to starter pinion. Count124,20degree pressure angle and full-depth involute form are estimates; no historical tooth count or mesh qualification. Largest diameter retained exactly.
evidence.key_screw_conflict: SNL203:019 and212 specify one No10(3/16)-24x3/4in flathead screw for SH136B. HB201 lists two SH64JH. Select SNL count when engine shaft/key installation is modeled; do not add both alternatives.
evidence.remaining: Complete crankshaft, key/screw/nut retention, thrust bearing and starter installation remain necessary. No duplicated crankshaft stub is added. Wire ends may be rerouted inward if the actual dished wheel obstructs the prior axial route.
